language_policy: English Only in all CLIs and Terminal interactions
fleet_pipeline_workflow: 1. Task Delegation: Issue structured Delegate Prompt (Template 02) to target CLI
2. Implementation & Test: Target CLI builds code and confirms zero analyze/lint errors
3. Mandatory Phase Code Review: Submit diffs & metrics for Quality Audit (Template 03)
4. Architectural Sign-off: Formal [APPROVED] verdict + ADR logging in MEMORY_STORE.md before unlocking next Phase

fleet_agents.assigned_role: Master Orchestrator, Staff Architect, Sole Test Authority & Senior Code Reviewer
fleet_agents.token_budget_strategy: Zero Boilerplate Writing - Architecture, Testing & Review Only

fleet_agents.assigned_role: Database, Remote Client & CLI Build Execution (NO TESTING)
Domain Logic, App Shell, UI Architecture & Memory Core

governing_constraints: Strictly adhere to Clean Architecture boundaries.
Do NOT modify locked dependency configurations without explicit coordinator approval.
Enforce zero linter / analyzer errors after every delivery.

Testing Monopoly: Strictly NO agent other than Claude Code CLI is permitted to execute tests or issue test sign-offs. Claude Code CLI alone executes all test suites, audits diffs, and approves code written by other agents.
Mandatory Code Review & Quality Audit (Template 03) at the end of every Phase before starting the next.
English-only communication in all terminal chats, logs, and delegate prompts.
